notes: Ran the same Obokata remote four times in one turn, declining the steal each time, then clicked for credits for about fifteen turns up to 50 credits without ever pressuring R&D or remotes while the Corp scored out.
Turn-2 Future Perfect behind one unrezzed ice was stolen, but afterwards the Corp scored steadily out of a single remote on a thin economy and closed quickly.

Repeated R&D runs that could only see the same top card, and after Hard-Hitting News it kept running instead of clearing tags, leaving 3 tags at 0 credits and getting flatlined by High-Profile Target.
Clean fast-advance plan with Seamless Launch and Offworld Office behind Hagen, scoring 4 agendas uncontested; nothing notably wrong.
Good steady R&D/HQ pressure that won, but it used Liza's draw-and-tag on almost every run with a full grip, causing repeated discards, endless 2-credit tag removals and nearly decking itself.

GFI and Cyberdex Sandbox went into a remote behind one Hagen the Runner could already break and were stolen, and the Corp spent several mid-game turns clicking for credits and discarding instead of icing HQ, which stayed behind one Border Control and leaked another agenda.

Slow start with many credit clicks while centrals were weak and an unrezzed Fairchild facecheck, then reasonable R&D/HQ pressure; it overdrew into big discards and nearly decked, and won only because the Corp decked.
Clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 35 credits and never ran HQ or R&D, letting a fast-advance Corp score 7 points unopposed.

Biotic Labor was spent just to click for credits, the Corp went broke trashing resources, and Ikawah and then Corporate Sales Team were put in a one-ice remote the Runner had already broken, both stolen.
Left R&D open turn 1 and lost an agenda to it, but then used Jeeves to install-and-score in one turn repeatedly and closed efficiently.
Rich and efficient scoring from one remote; it never iced R&D against a Runner hitting it four times a turn, which was risky but went unpunished.
Strong central pressure on open R&D and lightly iced HQ won quickly; minor oddities were paying to break Magnet after Hippo had already trashed it and running while still tagged.
Played Audacity with no target, dumping its whole hand including agendas into an open Archives, and left HQ and R&D unprotected for turns, giving the Runner 7 points by turn 4.
Installed nothing and clicked for credits almost every turn up to 79 credits, never contesting agendas advanced over several turns in lightly iced remotes.
An aggressive early Obokata steal and HQ hits won the game; the midgame was sluggish, including a 2-click Misdirection that removed zero tags and repeated empty Archives runs.
Installed no ice for most of the game, clicking for credits to 23 and discarding while the Runner hit open R&D every turn and took four agendas.
Persistent R&D pressure eventually won, but it lived at 0-1 credits for many turns, overdrew into discards, and could not contest a GFI advanced over two turns.
Spent most turns clicking for credits and discarding instead of building ice, leaving R&D open early and every central behind one Pup against an R&D Interface Runner who took agendas from centrals.
Left HQ unprotected for four turns against repeated HQ runs (GFI stolen) and put Cyberdex Sandbox behind one ice, but later built a layered remote and scored out with Offworld Office.
Facechecked Fairchild and Enigma with no breakers, played Calling in Favors for nothing, then clicked for credits for five turns while the Corp advanced agendas in single-ice remotes.
